verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev workflows are code-defined tasks with no workflow DSL, so 'create/update' means an agent writes code and deploys it rather than posting a workflow definition to an API. The official MCP server lets an agent initialize projects, deploy to environments and trigger runs, and a management API with secret-key/PAT authentication exists. This covers the agent-driven lifecycle only indirectly. Missing for 10: a documented public API endpoint to create or update a task/workflow definition, an explicit 'activate' operation (e.g. creating or enabling schedules via the API), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
